description: Check whether a known public data source (e.g. "noaa", "data.gov", "census.gov") is already on DataBazaar. Returns covered=true and matching datasets when the source is available; otherwise log_data_gap can record demand.

source_name.description: Short name of the data source (e.g. "noaa", "census", "data.gov")

source_url.description: Full URL of the data source (e.g. "https://noaa.gov") — will be normalized

name: check_coverage
